'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Turkey–Islamic State conflict]]
**Three [[Law enforcement in Turkey|police officers]] and six [[Islamic State]] gunmen are killed in a [[shootout]] during a raid at a house in Elmalık, [[Yalova Province]], [[Turkey]]. Eight other officers and a civilian are also wounded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/29/seven-turkish-police-officers-wounded-in-clash-with-isil-fighters-report (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Nine people are killed and 30 injured after smog-related accidents in [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1963991/nine-dead-30-injured-in-smog-related-accidents-in-punjab (Dawn)]
*Three people are killed and another is injured when an [[avalanche]] hits a [[ski resort]] on the [[Pyrenees]] in [[Panticosa]], [[Aragon]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/2151481/panticosa-ski-resort-avalanche-horror (''Daily Express'')]
*Two people are killed and British [[Boxing|boxer]] [[Anthony Joshua]] is injured when a car crashes into a stationary truck on the [[Lagos–Ibadan Expressway]] in [[Ogun State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c1w9vgr243dt (BBC News)] [https://www.tvcnews.tv/breaking-two-dead-as-anthony-joshua-convoy-crash-in-ogun (TVC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cross-strait relations]]
**[[Justice Mission 2025]]
***[[China]] conducts the largest [[live fire exercise]]s to date around [[Taiwan]], designating multiple sea and air zones for drills by [[People's Liberation Army Navy|naval]] and [[People's Liberation Army Air Force|air units]] to rehearse a [[blockade]] and to signal opposition to recent [[United States]] [[Arms industry|arms sales]] to Taiwan. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-launches-live-firing-drills-around-taiwan-its-biggest-war-games-date-2025-12-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[India–New Zealand relations]]
**[[India]] and [[New Zealand]] reach a [[free trade agreement]] where India grants zero-[[Duty (tax)|duty]] access for [[Foreign trade of India|its exports]] to New Zealand, and New Zealand receives phased concessions on most Indian [[tariff]] lines, while excluding [[Dairy farming in New Zealand|dairy]] and selected [[Agriculture in New Zealand|agricultural products]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-new-zealand-fta-dairy-modi-luxon-c7c6935528509aaaad00dbd79f1a583e (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Malaysia]]
**The [[Malaysia]]n [[Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission|Anti-Corruption Commission]] raids multiple companies and [[Asset freezing|freezes]] six bank accounts while investigating alleged [[bribery]] linked to [[Malaysian Army|army]] [[Military acquisition|procurement]] contracts, as [[Chief of Army (Malaysia)|army chief]] [[Muhammad Hafizuddeain Jantan]] is placed [[Leave of absence|on leave]] pending the inquiry. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-raids-several-firms-part-anti-graft-probe-into-army-procurement-2025-12-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[War crimes in the Syrian civil war]]
**The [[Syria]]n [[Syrian transitional government|transitional government]] orders the [[Syrian Armed Forces|military]] to secure a [[Mass graves in Syria|mass grave]] at a former military base near [[Al-Dumayr]], [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]], and opens a criminal investigation into a [[covert operation]] that transferred thousands of bodies there from another site during [[Presidency of Bashar al-Assad|the previous administration]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-secures-assad-era-mass-grave-revealed-by-reuters-opens-criminal-2025-12-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Three people are killed and four others are injured, including one critically, in a [[Livestreamed crime|livestreamed]] [[mass shooting]] when suspected [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] gunmen open fire on a [[Lamborghini]] in [[Zapopan]], [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]]. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/gunmen-film-targeted-shooting-on-lamborghini-in-western-mexico-3-killed/ (BNO News)]
*[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a [[Law of Russia|law]] allowing [[Federal Government of Russia|the government]] to disregard criminal judgments issued by foreign or [[international court]]s that lack a treaty basis or a [[United Nations Security Council]] mandate. [https://www.reuters.com/world/putin-amends-law-let-russia-ignore-foreign-criminal-courts-2025-12-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Iranian protests]]
**Protests erupt in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]], for a second day after the [[Iranian rial]] drops in value and [[inflation]] rates increase by 42.2%. The [[Governor of the Central Bank of Iran|leader]] of the [[Central Bank of Iran]] {{ill|Mohammad Reza Farzi|fa|محمدرضا فرزین}} resigns in response. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-traders-protest-rial-currency-ddc955739fb412b642251dee10638f03 (AP)]
*[[2025 Iraqi parliamentary election]]
**[[Haibat al-Halbousi]] of the [[Iraq]]i [[Progress Party (Iraq)|Progress Party]] is elected [[Speaker of the Council of Representatives of Iraq|Speaker]] of the [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|Council of Representatives]] following the recent parliamentary election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraqs-newly-elected-parliament-holds-first-session-2025-12-29/ (Reuters)]
